messages:
rachel_sales: Quick help — NebulaPOD POC getting 403s on /v1/generate. They pasted a failing curl and said it used our SDK. Can we swarm?

rachel_sales: curl they ran: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer neb_poc_9xy' -H 'X-Redwood-Org: nebula' -H 'X-Redwood-Project: default' -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-small\",\"input\":\"hey\"}'`

rachel_sales: Response: `{\"error\":\"permission_denied\",\"message\":\"key bound to org mismatch\"}`

josh_se: Ask whether they used the SDK or pasted manual headers; also ask for the exact header names the SDK emitted (it can change the project header to `default`).

rachel_sales: They say SDK set `X-Redwood-Org: nebula-corp` but their support console shows `nebula` in the app config. They also see `X-Redwood-Project: default` coming from the SDK.

tina_sre: I'll grep auth logs for key prefix `neb_poc_9xy`. @cli-bot fetch auth events 2187653721..2187654321 for that prefix.

cli-bot: Found events (redacted): 10 permission_denied (org-binding), 2 rate_limited. Sample: `AUTH FAIL key=neb_poc_9xy reason=org-mismatch bound_org=nebula-corp header_org=nebula request=/v1/generate`

tina_sre: Control-plane shows key bound_org=nebula-corp bound_project=nebula-poc key_type=service scopes=[generate]. If header_org doesn't match bound_org we 403.

josh_se: So the SDK was sending `nebula` as header value from app config while the key is bound to `nebula-corp`. We need them to use the exact org slug. Two fixes: update SDK config to nebula-corp or rotate the key to match `nebula`. Fastest: update SDK config.

rachel_sales: They updated SDK config to `nebula-corp` and retried — now 200s for normal calls. Still saw a couple 429s during a spike test.

tina_sre: 429s are sandbox per-key TPS. We can temporarily bump the key burst for the demo. Approve?

\jsosh_se: Approve +30 TPS for 30m. Also flag to docs: SDK defaulting to `default` project is confusing.

tina_sre: Applied sandbox_quota.bump key=neb_poc_9xy delta=+30 duration=30m. Monitor until 2187656121.

rachel_sales: Spike test passed, demo scheduled. Nebula asked about enterprise pricing if they need sustained higher TPS — I sent them a note to talk to AE.

sam_security: Two quick asks: 1) remind reps not to paste raw keys, 2) add a short line to presales FAQ: SDK config org must match key binding. Also log a docs ticket to make 403 msg suggest the expected org/project values.

josh_se: Filed DOCS-1221 for clearer error text and SDK README update. Closing swarm. :tada:
